ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $DE \parallel BC$, $AD=2$, $BD=3$, $AC=10$, what is the length of $AE$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $DE\parallel BC$, \\
it follows that $\frac{AD}{BD}=\frac{AE}{EC}=\frac{2}{3}$, \\
thus, $\frac{AE}{AC}=\frac{2}{5}$, \\
therefore, $AE=\frac{2}{5}AC=\frac{2}{5}\times 10=\boxed{4}$.
